results.title: FIFA stands firm on World Cup investment plan despite UEFA boycott threat
results.description: FIFA will continue discussions on its World Cup investment proposal despite UEFA’s boycott threat. The governing body says football is not for sale while CONCACAF also raises concerns over transparency, governance and the proposed private investment model.
